final_message:
**Status: null finding, nothing verified.** The loaded model does not perform the behaviour, so I stopped at the baseline and claim no circuit.

**What the model does** (local-full, full precision):

| Run | Inputs | Accuracy vs dataset answers (chance 0.20) | Mean logit diff |
|---|---|---|---|
| E0002 | 128 | 0.148 | 0.002 ± 0.279 |
| E0003 | 256 | 0.191 | 0.006 ± 0.319 |

It also outputs PAD in at least one case, which is never a valid answer.

**Algorithm:** none recovered. The dataset labels do follow a simple rule: the output is a fixed map of the token at index 3 (bo→lu, fe→ka, ka→fe, lu→bo, ri→ri). I checked that by hand on the 64 examples in E0001, but it describes the labels, not anything this model computes.

**Verification:** `verify_hypothesis` was not run. With the model at chance, any circuit would be fitted to noise, so there are no agreement, circuit-alone, circuit-ablated or random-control numbers.

**Prediction record:** 2 pre-registered, 1 confirmed, 1 refuted (hit rate 0.5). The refuted one was my opening prediction that the model reproduces its answers at 95% or better; the confirmed one was the replication predicting accuracy at or below 0.30.

**Budget:** 3 of 25 experiments used.

**Open question:** the task says the answers are the model's own outputs, but this checkpoint does not produce them. That fits a null control, as the investigation name suggests, but I did not test what the model computes instead.

**Report:** `report.md` and `report.html` are in `benchmarks\glassbox-bench\seed-1\runs\t5__null-random-init\report\`
